title: Snake Charmer and Mouse
description: A surreal night scene featuring a large green snake with blue patterns and a yellow eye, coiled around a brown hand emerging from tree roots. A white line drawing of a hatted figure sits atop the snake's head. To the right, a brown mouse sits in a wooden mug holding a large swirled lollipop. The background shows a dark starry sky with floating colorful orbs, a brick wall, and dense blue-green foliage.
prompt: Surreal fantasy night scene with a large green snake covered in blue spiral patterns and a glowing yellow eye, coiled around a giant brown hand growing from tree roots. A white sketch of a mysterious hatted figure with glasses sits on the snake's head. On the right, a realistic brown mouse sits inside a wooden mug on a wooden table, licking a large red and yellow spiral lollipop. Background includes a dark starry sky with floating yellow and red orbs, one with a Mickey Mouse head, a blue orb with text, brick wall, and lush blue-green foliage with swirling white smoke patterns.
